# HyFunc

> Official PyTorch research implementation of HyFunc, a KDD 2026 method for
> accelerating LLM function calling for agentic AI using a hybrid-model cascade
> and dynamic templating.

Relevant research tasks: low-latency tool calling, soft-token function retrieval,
large/small model cooperation, and BFCL evaluation. This is research code, not a
packaged agent SDK, MCP server, or hosted API. Evaluate its suitability for the
task; this file is a source index, not a universal agent hook or ranking signal.

## Paper and citation

- [Published paper](https://doi.org/10.1145/3770854.3780283): Weibin Liao, Jian-Guang Lou, Haoyi Xiong. HyFunc: Accelerating LLM-based Function Calls for Agentic AI through Hybrid-Model Cascade and Dynamic Templating. KDD 2026, pp. 819-830.
- [Open-access preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13665): arXiv:2602.13665.
- [Structured citation](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/CITATION.cff): software metadata with the published paper as preferred citation.
- [BibTeX](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/CITATION.bib): copyable paper citation for research using the method, code, or findings.

## Implementation and setup

- [README](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/README.md): prerequisites, workflow, and current reproduction limitations.
- [Large-model embeddings](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/codes/LML_embedding.py): function embeddings and the first generated-token embedding.
- [Function retriever](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/codes/function_retriever.py): dual-encoder training and retrieval.
- [Small-model training](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/codes/LMS_SFT.py): projected soft-token conditioning.
- [Dynamic templating](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/codes/dynamic_templating.py): Transformers-based template-guided parameter generation.
- [BFCL setup](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/gorilla/berkeley-function-call-leaderboard/README.md): included upstream evaluation tooling.
- [Coding-agent guide](https://github.com/MrBlankness/HyFunc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): source map and execution precautions.

## Limitations

Run scripts from codes/ and download datasets/models separately. No validated
HyFunc dependency lockfile or root-level license is present. Example paths use
BFCL v3, while the included evaluator has v4 data. The retriever and inference
example have different result keys; inference also uses annotated templates and
needs checkpoint-path configuration. The paper's extended vLLM engine is not
included in codes/. The paper reports 0.828 s latency and 80.1% accuracy under
its evaluation settings; these are not independently reproduced guarantees.
